verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs describe a first-party JavaScript embed library for putting scheduling links on your own site, both inline and as a popover. Its feature pages add a floating widget and triggering by hyperlink or JavaScript call, so all three modes in the story are covered. missing for 10: the actual embed snippet/installation code is not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the embeds working.
